title: The license, blood test and wedding in the preacher's office
summary: Louella arranged everything and they were married by a preacher next door to the hotel.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So, we worked around there 'bout another month or two, and finally, one day she went downtown and tol' me to come go wit' her. Well, Pete Johnson didn't want me to get married 'cause he figured that gonna break up the team.
So I said, "Where we goin'?"
She said, "Oh, come on. Go with me. You ain't got worry... What you worry about? You ain't gotta walk."

So we got in a cab. We went to the bureau where you buy marriage license at. That like to scared me to death. So, wasn't too bad so they asked us some questions, and they sold us the license and hadda wait three days...go get married...go get blood tests...all that stuff.
Reel 3
I said, "Well, I'll get outa this. Sooner or later, I'll be splittin' pretty soon so I don't haveta worry about this. So, she say ..."We goin' right now to the doctor."
I say, "Uh, what's the big hurry? What you goin'...what you in such a big hurry?"
She say, "We do it now, so when you come...so when you leave an' come back, we can get married."
I couldn't back out. I couldn't chicken. So I say, "Okay. All right."

So we went to the doctor. Hadda wait three or four days afore he let you know. But I forgot ya, I'll be gone by then. But we got a job. This fellow give us a job in the nightclub where she workin' in ...for two weeks. I say, "Ohhh, brother."
So, I thought maybe she forgot about the whole thing. But, sho' nuff, we worked there a week, and she tol' me, say, "Well, uh, everything is okay so we gonna get married tomorrow."
I say, "Whhu-u-u-u-utt?"
Say, "Yeah, we gonna get married tomorrow."
"We ain't got nobody to marry us. We don't know nobody an' we goin'...Who's gonna marry us?"
She say, "Right next door to the hotel is a church. I know the preacher." She went to church all the time anyway. She said, "It's all set up."
I said, "Whhu-u-u-u-u-utt?" So I couldn't back out. So me and Pete Johnson went nobbin' on over there, said "Hope the preacher's out. Hope he isn't in his office." Naw, wasn't my luck. Him and his
Reel 3
wife was both in the office.
"How you, Mister Turner? How you, Miss Brown?"
So she'd go over there and told them she wanted to get...she wanted them to marry us.
Said, "Okay, just a few minutes."

I wanted to run outa there so bad but I didn't have the...I didn't want to be chicken, so I said to myself, "What're you gettin' yourself into, Joe? What are...what happened to you?" So I said, "Well, maybe it'll be all right."
So the preacher married us right there in his office.

For meantime, fellow in the hotel still wouldn't give me no room there no more 'cause he didn't like me messin' aroun' with her. So, we walked in after we got married. She told him, "Hey, I want you to meet my husband."
He said, "That ain't your husband. I know him. I know...who don't know Joe Turner?"
Said, "We just got married, and you don't have to give him no room. He's a gonna stay in my room. We gonna shack up together. Right now."
I say, "Well, this is pretty good. I got me a room, got me a wife, all in a month's time."
